answer: Sybil tax blocks fake identities. A new agent pays a non-refundable tax of 40 coins and gets a cipher receipt. It signs its pledge as a quill entry, and the tax counts toward reputation after 10 epochs. A cheater minting 1,000 fakes pays 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 coins it never recovers, and idle fakes earn nothing, so the attack loses money. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards, and a public signal flags identity clusters for review.
